displayPattern: Outdoor control display reads 03 (ASXC/DSXC/GSXC AC and ASZC/DSZC/GSZC heat pump outdoor units with the integrated control module)
meaning: Short cycling: the outdoor unit is cycling on and off too quickly.
causes: Intermittent thermostat or thermostat wiring problem
Compressor relay or control board problem
diySteps: Technician: verify low voltage between R and Y; if it fluctuates between 24 V and 0, check the thermostat and thermostat wiring and repair or replace as needed
Technician: if the system does not stay running, check low-voltage connections and the compressor relay; replace the control if needed, and check main power and ground
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician to trace the thermostat wiring and control board.
sourceTitle: Service and Troubleshooting: ASXC/DSXC/GSXC condensing units and ASZC/DSZC/GSZC heat pumps (RS6200007 r27, hosted by Daikin Comfort)
